notes: Fixes: the large data burst sent when entering a dungeon (your character, party roster, Genus/pets/wings) could be shredded by the meter's stream reassembly - the root cause of 'owner sometimes not detected' and partial collection data - large fragmented frames are now reassembled correctly; owner detection overhauled - your character is identified reliably even when the zone snapshot arrives late or the game recycles entity ids, without needing combat traffic, and a stale cached identity can no longer take over your row; killed bosses are no longer re-uploaded after an internal reset; a fight is never uploaded without your own named row in it.
